page.overview:
What is Pawmot?

Pawmot is a rodent Pokémon that appears to be based on a [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Marmot Marmot ground squirrel]. Their bodies are a deep orange that is covered in scruffy fur. Like all electric-rodent Pokémon, they have yellow sacs on their cheeks that store electricity. It has large arms and small feet connected to legs that are mostly covered by thick layers of skin and fat. It also has yellow pads on its hands which are used when it releases electricity. It is a dual /-type Pokémon Despite the violent nature of the fighting type, this Pokémon is always smiling.

Although Pawmot's reaction speed is normally low, it is able to strike opponents with fast movements when battling. The fluffy fur on its body acts like a battery, allowing Pawmot to store as much electricity as in an electric car.

Pawmot is the only known Pokémon capable of learning the move Double Shock.

Pawmot evolves from Pawmo if leveled up while outside of its Poké Ball after walking 1000 steps using the Let's Go feature and if the final evolution of Pawmi.
